End member parameters are denoted by the subscript species. Each of the expressions above are meant only for changes in composition across a single phase. Temperature models for these same parameters (also for changes across a single phase) may be constructed as well. In practice, these tend to be emperical fitting forms based on gross theoretical behavior. Given the great number of cautions presented explicitly in the text above, it is important to state that the uncertainties derive from a lack of data with which to bolster models of behavior. In the practical world of metal casting and metal processing it is well understood that these heavily caveated scientific statements can still represent the best available information from which simulations of system behavior must be built if they are to be built at all.
